title: The real danger of black market peptides: Novo Nordisk CEO
title_zh: 黑市肽的真正危险：诺和诺德首席执行官
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi chats with Novo Nordisk CEO Mike Doustdar about the alarming rise of untested, black-market peptides being pushed by influencers online.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经执行编辑布莱恩·索齐 (Brian Sozzi) 与诺和诺德 (Novo Nordisk) 首席执行官迈克·杜斯特达尔 (Mike Doustdar) 讨论了网红在网上推销未经测试的黑市肽的惊人增长情况。

title: Weight loss is just the beginning of GLP-1's: Novo Nordisk CEO
title_zh: 诺和诺德首席执行官：减肥只是 GLP-1 的开始
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi chats with Novo Nordisk CEO Mike Doustdar about the true timeline for how GLP-1s will impact the food and airline industries, and what the future of weight loss and preventative health looks like over the next decade.
summary_zh: 雅虎财经执行编辑 Brian Sozzi 与诺和诺德首席执行官 Mike Doustdar 讨论了 GLP-1 将如何影响食品和航空业的真实时间表，以及未来十年减肥和预防性健康的未来。
